title: Nau Gul E Gulzar E Haram Aaye Ali Asgher Aziz E Maadar
body:
Nau Gul E Gulzar E Haram Aaye Ali Asgher, Aziz E Maadar
Daagh E Toh Su Das Jigaram Aaye Ali Asgher, Aziz E Maadar
1.Asghar'aain Kodheke Maai Paara E Ni Koosiaaram, Ali Asgher Pisaram
Dagh E Margh E Toh Zaada Aatish E Qanbar Jigaram, Ali Asgher Pisaram
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Gul E Nash Gufta E Man Ghuncha E Lab Raaba Kusha, Beruqham Qanda Numa
Taaba Bo Saam Laabe Shireen Toh Bachahsme Taram, Ali Asgher Pisaram
